verdict.rationale: Framer's in-product agent can restructure a user's homepage based on conversion best practices (framer-docs-31, framer-docs-38), and the CMS agent organizes and links imported content (framer-docs-8, framer-docs-9). These are AI-driven suggestions applied to the user's own site and content, but there is no evidence of insights derived from the user's data, such as analytics or performance analysis. missing for 10: AI-generated insights from site or analytics data, data-driven recommendations surfaced proactively in the product, documentation of an insights feature, independent or hands-on corroboration.
